prioritized_backlog.rule: Targeting state leaks -> a cancelled play leaves the board mid-targeting. Make play atomic: validate cost + targets first, then commit.

prioritized_backlog.rule: Model screens as a stack. Push (pause/modal over game), pop (resume/reset), with input + visibility handed to the top screen.

prioritized_backlog.rule: Define actions, not raw keys; guard global key handlers when native form/select controls hold focus and expose all gameplay actions to keyboard.
